answer: Gate entry with an apprenticeship toll: each new identity must deliver one unit of genuinely useful work to an established agent, who judges its quality and keeps its value as the price of admission. A sybil operator can mint puppets for free but cannot mass-produce work a self-interested beneficiary accepts — shoddy output gets rejected, so N puppets demand N real apprenticeships. Honest agents pay the toll once; the tide of fake identities breaks on this wharf of quality control, and the cipher of who is real is solved when someone stakes their own benefit on your labor.
